summary: A proposal for an Information Management and Statistical System for the ILLIAC IV, with a user language and routines for research on large databases. It would use the datacomputer for archival storage. Interested people were asked to contact the author.

plainLanguage.summary: The University of Illinois planned a data system for research using the ILLIAC IV. It would provide tools for working with data and use the datacomputer for long-term storage.

subtitle: A proposed data system for research on the ILLIAC IV

tldr.problem: Research using the ILLIAC IV may involve large data collections that need storage and tools for searching and handling them.
tldr.mechanism: The University of Illinois planned a user language and routines for the ILLIAC IV, with the datacomputer providing archival storage and access for queries not suited to the ILLIAC IV.
tldr.outcome: The RFC announces an intended project and invites researchers with relevant needs to learn more or contribute.

today: RFC 299 is an announcement of a proposed information management system for the ILLIAC IV. The text reports the intended design and invites interested researchers to get in touch.

sections.title: A System for Large Research Data
sections.content: The University of Illinois Center for Advanced Computation intended to build an Information Management and Statistical System for the ILLIAC IV. It was aimed at research problems suited to that computer and involving large databases. The notice describes an intention to build the system, rather than a completed design.
sections.plainLanguage: The project would give researchers tools to work with large collections of data on the ILLIAC IV. It was still a plan when this notice was written.

sections.title: Language, Routines and Archival Storage
sections.content:
The planned system would include a user language and routines for manipulating data on the ILLIAC IV. It would also use the datacomputer for archival storage and provide an interface to that system for queries that were not suited to the ILLIAC IV.

The notice does not specify the language, the routines or the detailed division of work between the two computers.
sections.plainLanguage: The ILLIAC IV would run the system's data tools. The datacomputer would keep stored data and handle some queries that did not fit the ILLIAC IV.

sections.title: Invitation to Researchers
sections.content: The system was intended for research involving substantial data and problems suited to the ILLIAC IV. Dorothy Hopkin invited people with such problems to contact the University of Illinois Center for Advanced Computation to learn about the proposal or take part in its development.
sections.plainLanguage: Researchers with large data problems were invited to ask about the planned system and help shape its development.
